content: This medication should not be used during pregnancy. It is known to pass into breast milk and may negatively affect both the quality and quantity of milk production. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. It is important to maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as the metyrapone test, potentially leading to inaccurate test results. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. For non-emergency situations, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Regular Monitoring: While taking this medication, it is essential to undergo regular comprehensive physical examinations, including laboratory and medical tests such as blood pressure monitoring, breast exams/mammograms, pelvic exams, and Pap smears. Follow your doctor’s instructions for self-examination of your breasts and report any lumps immediately. Ensure you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. Preventive Health Measures: Managing or preventing high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and diabetes can significantly reduce the risk of heart disease and stroke. Lifestyle changes that can help include reducing stress, following a low-fat and low-salt diet, losing weight if overweight, exercising regularly, and quitting smoking. To help prevent dementia, keep your mind active with mental exercises such as reading or solving crossword puzzles. For healthy bones, engage in weight-bearing exercises, avoid smoking, limit alcohol consumption, and eat a well-balanced diet rich in calcium and vitamin D. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most current formulary information, as individual plans may vary and formulary details can change.
